tasks.answer: FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen (export name FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen) is the 'flight delay compensation batch workspace' page component. Import it from @/features/flight-delay-compensation/batch-detail-screen. Required prop: batchId. It supports standard, special and review compensation steps and additionally needs query, auth and router providers; it also handles offline/conflict states.

No dedicated special-passenger (特殊旅客) booking-list variant exists in the catalog. The only booking list screen returned for this task is the general TravelerBookingListScreen (export TravelerBookingListScreen) from @/features/traveler-bookings/booking-list-screen. Required prop: navigate (options: NavigateOptions) => void | Promise<void>; optional initialStatus (number). It is a paginated traveler booking list with search and filters; queries/actions are permission-gated. Special-traveler filtering is not exposed as a separate component or prop variant, so special-passenger lists must be built on this general list (e.g. via filtering) rather than a dedicated variant.

PasswordInput (export default) from @/features/auth/password-input has no required props; it renders a password field with show/hide labels. Error display: it must be used inside UiFormField, and the error is a string shown by the field wrapper (UiFormField renders the error message), not by PasswordInput itself. Production usage example: new-password field in src/features/identity/change-password-page.tsx.

Both are shared-ui business/mobile primitives exported from @/components/business/mobile. (1) business.SearchBar (export SearchBar): required props value, placeholder, onChange; onFilter is optional and adds the filter icon button. (2) business.FilterSheet (export FilterSheet): required props visible, title, children, onClose; onConfirm runs before the sheet closes, and it provides reset/confirm actions.

common.AuthRecoveryDialog (export AuthRecoveryDialog) from @/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog has no required props. It is a global dialog: mount it once near the app root; it subscribes to the auth recovery store and lazily renders AuthRecoveryDialogView (which requires a detail prop), and renders null while no recovery event is pending.
